synchronizationRules: English documents remain authoritative when a translation differs.
Before every release, compare README.zh.md with README.md and synchronize installation, configuration, compatibility, and current-use details.
Update both recorded snapshot versions from package.json and run the language-policy check; a release is incomplete until synchronization is confirmed.
Translate structural or operational README documents when useful; do not create translated copies of every detailed engineering document.
preservedLanguageData: Localized application interfaces and locale dictionaries.
Original statutory holiday names, official-source titles, legal references, and citations.
Localized test fixtures, expected strings, and multilingual examples.
